description: Searches Treasury bi-weekly Judgment Fund payment lines in one fiscal year of the MORVS Judgment Fund Register. Defaults to the latest published fiscal year, which may be incomplete. Filters by named organisation payee, Treasury responsible agency or MORVS agency group, and minimum known grouped amount. Returns separate source lines grouped by named payee, agency and report period; unnamed lines remain separate. Includes payee status, Treasury report links and source row numbers. Individuals are never named. A payment is not an admission of fault; a line is not a settlement, and split or identical lines remain separate payments. The bi-weekly and annual Treasury products are separate and must never be added.

agency.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against agency or agency group.

fy.description: Fiscal year, default latest published. Treasury products are separate and are never added.

limit.description: Maximum returned payment groups or lines, allowed 1-100. A line is not a settlement.

min_amount.description: Minimum known amount of a returned payee, agency and period group, in dollars.

payee.description: Case-insensitive payee substring. Names for individual or otherwise unnamed payees are never returned.

name: judgment_fund_payments
title: Find Judgment Fund Payments
